policy: Every colour that is styling comes from a token in @theme. Colour that is data is listed, by file, with its reason.

dataColors.src/app/(app)/page.js: fallback colour for a priority that carries none
dataColors.src/app/(app)/settings/page.js: the palette a person picks a brand colour from, and the stored sidebarColor
dataColors.src/app/(app)/sprints/page.js: StatusPill is handed a colour, the way a status from the database is
dataColors.src/components/InviteLinkSection.jsx: the QR generator takes two literal colours
dataColors.src/components/SearchModal.jsx: fallback colour for a type that carries none
dataColors.src/components/workspace/AgileBoard.jsx: the synthetic «Приховані» lane carries a colour like every other lane
dataColors.src/components/workspace/BillingTab.jsx: the invoice print document is injected into a window that cannot see the app CSS
dataColors.src/components/workspace/IssueCard.jsx: fallback colours for a type or status that carries none
dataColors.src/components/workspace/IssueDetail.jsx: fallback colours for a type or priority that carries none
